// divguard:path agent/agent.go

package agent

import "context"

type Event struct{}

type Agent struct {
	runCtx  context.Context
	EventCh chan Event
}

// emit reproduces AGENT-01: after an abort both cases are ready, so the
// terminal agent_end is dropped about half the time.
func (a *Agent) emit(ev Event) {
	select {
	case a.EventCh <- ev: // want
	case <-a.runCtx.Done():
	}
}

func forward(ctx context.Context, listenerCh chan<- Event, ev Event) {
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return
	case listenerCh <- ev: // want
	}
}
